lizard.story: Nicknamed 'The Lizard' at the poker table. Built Starlizard, a betting-research firm, and used the winnings to buy Brighton & Hove Albion. His edge: patient models and leagues the bookmakers watch less closely.
lizard.style: Hunts second-division football where prices are lazy. Waits for a clear gap, then strikes hard.

quant.name: The Quant
quant.story: Turned an NBA obsession into one of betting's best-known careers by spotting how bookmakers misjudged the way games actually play out: pace, rotations, coaches' habits. Later ran analytics for the Dallas Mavericks and bought Spanish club CD Castellón.
quant.style: Bets NBA total points, where tempo and tired legs move the numbers more than the bookmakers think.
